ftbquests.chapter.abandoned_farm.quest6E: Completeting the Abandoned Farm gives you a &3Petal Apothecary&r. This is your entry point into Botania, a magical automation mod that will help with certain tasks around the farm.
ftbquests.chapter.abandoned_farm.title: Abandoned Farm
ftbquests.chapter.armor_weapons__tools.q: &6Hooks&r allow you to get out of ditches fast and climb tall mountains.
They need to be in your curio slot and are activated using a hotkey.
You can buy one from the &6Guild&r.
&eElectrum Tools&r increase in damage the faster the wearer is. This combines well with the armor, allowing you to rip and tear through mobs.
They also come built in with &6Fortune III&r.
The &6Red Hook&r is a special one that allows you to have creative flight in a small area defined by the hooks.
This makes your hook fairly useless for traveling however.
Creative flight is rare, so this will likely be your first way of obtaining it.
The &6Iridium&r variants of the Backtank and Diving Helmet let you dive in lava, provided you have air.
You'll also need the full set of &6Iridium&r equipment to do so.
The &6Ender Hook&r is the fastest and highest range of all hooks, but only has one hook. Best for traveling, not as good for building.
The &6Dragontooth Axe&r can only be wielded if you have the skill &6Dragonslayer&r on the Adventurer skill tree.
It's slow, extremely powerful, and does all the things an axe can!
&6Iridium&r tools and weapons are the equivalent of &6Netherite&r in vanilla minecraft, with slightly increased attack damage and dig speed.
&6Gold&r tools have increased attack damage, dig speed, and durability to &6Iron&r, unlike what you might expect in vanilla Minecraft.
The &6Flamarang&r is the upgraded version of &6Pickarang&r that cannot be destroyed by lava.
It also has higher damage and durability.
&3Neptunium&r can be found from Neptune's Bounty, Crab Traps, and Neptuna.
The armors give buffs to underwater movement, breathing, and utility.
Pickaxes and shovels aren't the only way to mine blocks. These tools are sidegrades for mining that have various effects that make mining easier.
&6Pickarangs&r can be used to mine at range, bringing drops back for you.
It works on any type of block a Diamond Pickaxe, Shovel, or Axe can.
All armor must start off with a leather or wool base.
Wool clothing can also be sewn if you can aquire a &6Sewing Table&r from a &6Market&r villager
The &6Potato Cannon&r uses air in your backtank to launch vegetables at dangerous velocity.
&6Iridium&r armors are the equivalent of &6Netherite&r in vanilla minecraft, with slightly increased protection.
&3Neptunium&r can be found from Neptune's Bounty, Crab Traps, and Neptuna.
The tools typically remove the underwater mining penalty, and weapons deal more damage underwater.
&6Backtanks&r can be charged with air via create rotation, and store air that can be used to breathe underwater while wearing a diving helmet.
The &6Blaze Hook&r is a direct upgrade in speed, but only has two hooks. It also sets mobs on fire if they pass through the hook chain.
&6Mining Dynamite&r is highly efficient at breaking stone, dropping all the items on the ground at the point of contact.
The &6Diamond Hook&r increases the amount of hooks by 2, range of the hooks, and speed.
The &6Extendo-Grip&r uses air to extend your reach for both placing, breaking, and attacking.
This chapter lists armor, tools, weapons, and other items that will help you on your journey to dominate the land.
It also lays out the tool progression.
&6Hammers&r are powerful tools that will let you break multiple blocks at a time.
They require cores to be crafted, and can be upgraded to increase range and metal tier.
Unfortunately, &l&6they do not pass enchantments to the upgraded tool&r due to a bug that the modpack dev can't figure out. Sorry!
&eElectrum Armor&r increases the speed of the user by a significant amount, making them ideal for long range travel.
&6Iron Hooks&r have two hooks, allowing you to float in midair.
&6Gold&r armors have increased protection and durability to &6Iron&r, unlike what you might expect in vanilla Minecraft.
The &dGalaxy Sword&r is one of the most powerful swords in the game. It can be crafted with a &dPrismatic Shard&r and an Iridium Sword..

ftbquests.chapter.banners.quest1280C34AE: Cook all dishes from &6Let's Do: Candlelight&r.
ftbquests.chapter.banners.quest1FFF66E7B: Cook all dishes from &6Farm and Charm&r.
ftbquests.chapter.banners.quest44256671D: Cook all dishes from &6Farmer's Delight&r, &6Crabber's Delight&r, &6Veggies's Delight&r and &6Vintage Delight&r.
ftbquests.chapter.banners.quest7A159242A: Cook all dishes from &6Let's Do: Bakery&r.

ftbquests.chapter.boiler_room.quest3428A: Completing the Boiler Room gives you the &6Kinetic Blueprint&r!
This item allows you to craft power sources for the &6Create&r mod, allowing you to fully automate your farm!
ftbquests.chapter.boiler_room.title: Boiler Room
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest137994A31: &6Functional Flora&r are classified as magical flowers that utilize mana for peforming various actions.
The &6Lexica Botania&r will have information on all the different types.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest13A0704DC: By ascending your mana pylons into &6Gaia Pylons&r, you can engage in a deadly battle with the primal magical world...
You should refer to your &6Lexica Botania&r for the details.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest18EDA9E25: Keeping up with milking farm animals can be time consuming with all your other farming chores. The &6Mana Milker&r does this for you by gently milking farm animals using &bMana&r received from a Mana Spreader.
Unlike Deployers, farm animals don't mind being milked by this, but they won't receive affection from being milked like usual.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest1BF054DD1: Once grown, Mystical flowers can be crafted into petals that are used to magically create different flowers.
You'll need at least &6white&r, &6yellow&r, and &6orange&r to start magic.
&oPetals cannot be planted and bonemeal like you may be able to do in other packs...&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest1CC084C4F: &6Terrasteel armor&r is a highly protective armor with various bonuses for the botanical master.
Unlike mundane armors, it takes durability damage from attacks, but can slowly be repaired using any mana in your inventory.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest1D0F4F3CF: &6Bismuth&r is a metal that works as a conduit for magic.
Toss an ingot into a filled Mana Pool to create &6Manasteel&r, a common crafting ingredient for magic.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest247D9F5D8: Harvesting from fruit trees with your bare hands gets old.
The &6Cornucopia&r harnesses elven wind magic to knock ripe fruits down for collection.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest24D0021DB: &6Mana Crab Trap Bait&r can be crafted from various magical materials on a Runic Altar.
It catches even less trash and more fish than &6Deluxe Crab Trap Bait&r, with a chance to fish up rare and valuable aquatic loot.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest27437A0F6: While the Cropnolia may be a good start for generating mana, it's far from the fastest.
&6Generating Flora&r are classified as flowers that are able to synthesize mana. As you progress, look to utilize the different types to upgrade your mana generating capacity.
The &6Lexica Botania&r will have information on all the different types.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest31BC474EE: A &6Heart of Diamond&r has enough magical energy to be transformed into a &6Mana Diamond&r using mana when tossed into a pool.
If a heart isn't available, a tribute of a &6Diamond Block&r can be transformed into one as a substitute.
Both transformations require a significant amount of mana.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest33B78DFDD: To use the mana stored in your &6Cropnolia&r, you'll need two devices.
The &6Mana Spreader&r is placed near your flower, and can move mana from it into a &6Mana Pool&r.
Using the &6Wand of the Forest&r, Shift + Right Click the Cropnolia, and then the Mana Spreader.
Finally, Shift + Right click the Mana Spreader and then the Mana Pool to bind them.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest3B0A3083F: With the power of the runes, an even greater power can be reached.
Follow the directions for assembling the &6Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r in the Lexica Botania.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest3C7C3242A: The &6Cropnolia&r is your entrypoint to magic, converting fully grown crops in a 7x7 area around it into &bMana&r proportional to how long they took to grow.
It should be planted in a field where the harvest isn't so important, as crops that are culled by the Cropnolia do not drop anything.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest3EC0E2F63: The &6Pure Daisy&r is an essential flower. When logs or stone are placed in the 8 spaces around it, they are slowly converted into more magical variants.
You'll need plenty of these blocks to progress through magic.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest42DA09B2A: There are certain fruits native to Alfheim that the elves will be willing to trade for.
In return they require their overworldian counterparts.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest44C80D7C3: In order to work with botanical magic, you need the petals of &aMystical Flowers&r.
Fill the &6Petal Apothecary&r using a &6Water Bucket&r. From there, you'll need to toss 4 of a crop depending on the petal color, and any kind of seed.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest46F86152B: &6Terrasteel&r is the beginning of the most powerful items botanical magic has to offer.
You'll need half a Mana Pool's worth of mana to craft a Terrasteel ingot, provided using &6Sparks&r.
Toss the four required items on the plate, and be careful not to interrupt the ritual by picking up a crafting item.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest4AF0A4341: &6Pearls&r are inherently magical in nature, but throwing one in a Mana Pool will bring out the energy using mana.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest4DE0F1BAD: The Terra set of tools and weapons have various bonues.
- &6Truncators&r fell trees in a single blow
- &6Shatterers&r allow you to mine in a large area, and can be upgraded using mana to increase the area mined up to 9x9
- &6Blades&r come with an additional ranged attack using mana
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest52AB7E364: Sparkstone is not an easy resource to aquire. &bMana&r can be used to harness the remnants from Sparkstone consuming machines.
&6Sparkstone Recyclers&r can be attached to any side of the machine. The recycling chance stacks additively for each of them attached.
Mana Spreaders must be used to give them &bMana&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest5797BBD77: The &6Elven Gateway&r is the link between the otherworldy, giving you access to materials beyond this mortal plane's comprehension.
Once activated according to the instructions in the &6Lexica Botania&r, items can be thrown in as an offering.
You should start by tossing your Lexica Botania in.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest5E5E6E09E: Completing the &6Abandoned Farm&r yields a device used for elvish flower magic. It's difficult to obtain but studying this magic will undoubtly be useful to developing your farm.
The &6Lexica Botania&r will tell you most things you need to know about magic, and this questline will highlight Sunlit Valley specific applications.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest61F2F0C46: The &6Flugel Tiara&r is one of the few forms of creative flight in Sunlit Valley.
It consumes &bMana&r from rings or tablets in your inventory, and a dash can be performed by double tapping the directional keys.
&oMight need some extra pocket change to afford making this...&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest631D3F502: Infusing &6Animal Feed&r with mana by dropping it into a &6Mana Pool&r makes it tastier to farm animals!
It takes a decent amount of mana to make, but it will save you tons of time when raising new animals.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest656E19A85: The &6Galliraptor&r and &6Tri-Bull&r are mysterious farm animals conjured from massive amounts of mana.
You'll need an &bentire Mana Pool&r worth of mana to summon one, alongside an array of animal products to graft onto the hungry rune.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest69A2A84A2: &6Runes&r unlock the magical potential of the earth, allowing you to create more complex devices and flora.
They are crafted by tossing one of each ingredient into a &6Runic Altar&r and filling the altar with mana using a spreader.
Once the mana has filled, toss a piece of &6Living Rock&r on and use the &6Wand of the Forest&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest6DAC81A05: &6Mana Fruits&r are the heart of advanced magical constructs.
They are filled with mana during growth using a &6Mana Spreader&r, and wither away when they don't have enough mana to grow.
&oIf you haven't done so at this point, you should look to increase your automatic production of mana.&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest768A5A216: The &6Mana Clock&r is a machine that heavily uses &bMana&r from a Mana Spreader to altar time around it.
It is used in conjunction with &6Aging Casks&r and &6Ancient Casks&r to reduce the overall amount of time they take to process.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest78F0A0A70: &6Mystical Flowers&r cannot be found in the world and &6Floral Fertilizer&r are disabled in this pack. Don't bother searching for hours around the world for either!
Why can't I find Mystical Flowers?
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest796B163FC: Pointing a mana spreader at each of your &6Mana Fruit&r crops can be a tad annoying.
The &6Mana Sprinkler&r can send mana to nearby &6Mana Fruit&r, with the same area as a &6Gold Sprinkler&r!
&oIt also keeps farmland watered like a mundane sprinkler.&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest7E6A0CF4C: Runes can be harnessed to create oceanic weather changing shells. The &6Fluvial Shell&r sets the weather to rain, and is used as a base. These have a low durability, so careful usage is recommended.
Using more advanced runes, you create two mystical shells.
The &6Thunderous Shell&r turns the weather into a thunderstorm, while the &6Clement&r clears all weather.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.questB3038ABD8: Strangely enough, the energies of magic demand a financial tribute to work in your favor.
You shouldn't neglect your income on the farm, the flowers demand it.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.title: IV.II - Mystical Farming
ftbquests.chapter.crafts_room.quest75914: The reward for completing the Crafts Room is the magnificant &6Magic Mirror&r!
This item takes you to your bed/spawn when used, provided its in range of the mirror.
&6Relic Experience&r can be used to upgrade the range.
ftbquests.chapter.crafts_room.title: Crafts Room
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest1050F9A: &6Reinforced Golems&r are hulking beasts of immense wealth.
They are built by the hardened hands of wealthy farmers (View recipes for a Carved Pumpkin).
They can be ridden and lit with a &6Lava Bucket&r for combat purposes, but they're mainly a status symbol in the valley.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest148CCCD: &6Coal Golems&r hang around their ores, waiting to be lit with a Flint and Steel to fight monsters.
They're mostly here for moral support.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest28EE102: &6Candle Golems&r can be created by crafting a &6Candle Golem Block&r. Like a pet, they can be told to sit or stand.
When lit, they'll shoot nearby mobs with projectiles as long as they last.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest3225DF5: &6Honey Golems&r love bees! They'll act as mobile hives that produce a special kind of honey.
&6Honey Blobs&r can be made into a &6Bear Slime Heart&r in a Plort Press.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest33E3889: &6Barrel Golems&r are full of stuff! But they need &6Emeralds&r, the currency of the ancient world.
They can spawn around your villagers and traded with just like Piglins.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest5045DE5: &6Sun Golems&r are interesting creatures that come from the ancient power of the valley.
They can either be found in the world or built, and will provide various benefits for a farmer that can utilize them.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest5FEA1AC: &6Kelp Golems&r love taking on drowned, especially with a nearby Conduit. They need water to breathe!
They can be crafted (see recipes for Dried Kelp) and water nearby Garden Pots periodically.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest6021F74: They can spawn around your villagers or built by hand (View recipes for a Carved Pumpkin).
They will periodically upgrade the quality of nearby farmland, provided that no other &6Hay Golems&r are nearby to disturb them.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest66C03C4: &6Slime Golems&r are natural therapists, and will improve the happiness of nearby Splendid Slimes.
Unfortunately, these golems get frustrated by their petty splendid problems and will take it out on the Slimes...
They can be found in Slime chunks.
ftbquests.chapter.creatures.quest7BEAE86: &6Terracotta Golems&r are fierce fighters and artisans. They can be found in Badlands or crafted using a &6Clay Golem Statue&r that's placed near fire.
They can be given a &6Cactus&r or a &6Dead Bush&r to improve their combat abilities.
More importantly, they will turn nearby &6Coarse Dirt&r into &6Clay&r.

Nice work, we suppose.
Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
More EV Circuits!
&aGasoline&r is an extremely powerful Combustion Fuel. It's over &63 times&r as energy dense as &dDiesel&r!
&9Note:&r This Combustion Fuel exists solely as a &echallenge&r for you to overcome if you desire to take on it.
It's completely &doptional&r, so we'll let you figure out how to obtain it, without any further tips.
Gasoline
&6Multiply the energy density by 2&r and you have &aHigh Octane Gasoline&r.
&9Note:&r Automating this requires a lot of &3Distillation Towers&r! A huge portion of your base would be dedicated to producing this constantly without anything bottlenecking.
If you have a base successfully running on &aHOG&r, feel free to brag and share some screenshots on our &8Discord&r.
Fetch me my Draconium!
High Octane Gasoline
&aRTM Alloy Coils&r raise the Heat Capacity to a scorching &d4,500K&r.
These will be required in &9IV&r, but as always, you should get them earlier for the &6Coil bonuses&r.

&l&3Lore:&r&o These coils used to be Tungstensteel Coils. This however made most of the EV tier very easy to skip over and postpone to IV, so they were changed to the new RTM Alloy. GTNH was the first to make this change, and used TPV Alloy instead, made from Titanium, Platinum, and Vanadium.
&o&7Which coil do you prefer?
What happened to my Tungstensteel!?
RTM Alloy Coils
&aUranium&r has very few uses in &2GTCEu&r right now, as we're &4yet to&r implement our &3Nuclear Reactor&r (it's planned!).
Make &dUranium Hexafluoride&r from &aUraninite&r. This will allow you to seperate the isotopes between U-238 and U-235.
{@pagebreak}
&9Fluorine&r is fully recycled in the reaction, but you will need around maybe 40 buckets to bootstrap.

&9Hydrogen&r is consumed, so you will need quite a lot of it. Either electrolyze a lot of water using several &3LV Electrolyzers&r for the best energy efficiency, or recycle any unused &dhydrocarbons&r such as Methane.
&9Tip:&r You can make this setup compact by having one single &3Centrifuge&r and using a &6Fluid Regulator&r set to &dSupply Exact 1,000&r.
Let's hope this quest doesn't put you on a list
Uraninite Dust
Uranium Refinement
Tungsten in Swedish translates directly as "Heavy Stone", which is pretty funny. You may know of this element as Wolfram too, hence its formula being W.
&aTungsten&r will be the main &1IV&r Cable material, but will also show its face elsewhere!
Wolfram Alpha
Tungsten
The &3Large Gas Turbine&r may not impress you in &5EV&r, but it can scale to &9better production&r than the base 4096 EU/t, and boasts &9higher efficiency&r than those pesky singleblock generators.
Each Large Turbine will require a &aTurbine Rotor&r and a &3Rotor Holder&r. More on the Turbine mechanics in the &lnext&r Quest.
{@pagebreak}
&9Note:&r This Quest &eonly&r requires the Controller, but obviously you still need all the multiblock parts to construct the Turbine.
Turbines &cvoid&r energy if they're unable to output. If you plan on using this with HV power, use a Rotor with close to 100% Power stat.
Gassed Up
Large Gas Turbine
&aLiquid Air&r is a great way to get large amounts of &aNitrogen&r and &aOxygen&r at the cost of using more energy than &3LV Centrifuges&r.
However, this will also give you both &6Helium&r and &6Argon&r - which are great to boost smelting in the &3Electric Blast Furnace&r.
&cNote:&r You will need at least &3HV Input and Output Hatches&r to be able to run this recipe.
True Distillation: Air
At the cost of 4x the drilling Power, the &3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig&r gains &616x the output&r in Fluid.
The depletion of veins is also halved. This means you will get a total of &632x&r as much Oil (or whatever fluid) from a bedrock fluid vein until depletion!
Even when depleted, you can still use this and be firmly power positive.
One single &3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig&r should be enough to supply Power for a base up to &dLuV&r... and possibly beyond!
{@pagebreak}
As a &9reminder&r, since this last appeared in &bMV&r:
&9-&r &aLight Oil&r can be used for &dLPG&r and &dMethane&r to run in &3Large Gas Turbines&r.
&9-&r &aOil&r can be used for &dDiesel&r and &dCetane-Boosted Diesel&r to run in &3Large Combustion Engines&r.
&9-&r &aHeavy Oil&r can be used for &dNitrobenzene&r to run in &3Large Gas Turbines&r.
"Extreme" is an apt descriptor
Extreme Fluid Drilling
Water, water, everywhere!
Reservoir Hatch
&aEpoxy&r is the foundation for all future Circuit Boards in the game. Get ready to make a lot of this stuff.
Doing this will probably require you to make some Quadruple Pipes, Pump Covers, Fluid Filters... or route everything using AE2.
In general, closed loop setups are nice to prevent overproduction or overconsumption, but go for whatever's more fun for you.
&9&lNote:&r This questline is quite complicated, so tackle everything else before trying to make Epoxy. You'll need all the help you can get!
{@pagebreak}
There are several ways to obtain the ingredients for &aEpoxy&r.
We'll ignore recipes related to Glycerol, as they're never worth it unless modpack devs tweak things around. &mHint hint, if you're making your own pack!&r
Try and use &3Large Chemical Reactors&r to shortcut recipes.
{@pagebreak}
&dChlorine&r is only partially recycled, so you'll need a constant supply. Feeding it manually should be sufficient at first.
Recipes involving &dSodium Hydroxide&r could be looped by electrolyzing the &9Salt Water&r co-product.
Prime circuit board material

&cTNT&r (Trinitrotoluene, to be pedantic) can't be prepared with the usual "Gunpowder and Sand" routine anymore. Instead, you'll have to produce &aGelled Toluene&r and react it with Sulfuric Acid to make TNT.

Using the &3HV Chemical Reactor&r recipe will double the yield of &aGelled Toluene&r at the cost of requiring additional inputs.
{@pagebreak}

That being said, don't miss out on the direct &aHeavy Fuel&r to &aToluene&r recipe in the single block &3Distillery&r.
&aToluene&r can also optionally be used in &5EV&r to make &dGasoline&r.
&cTNT&r is used in the &3Implosion Compressor&r to make Gems. It also blows stuff (and your friends) up.

The &3Cleanroom&r is a hollow multiblock free of contaminants. Going forward, most new &acircuit-related recipes&r, as well as some unique blocks like &3Fusion Casings&r, will need to be run in machines inside a Cleanroom.
Creating it will put your &aPolyethylene&r automation to the test for all the &dPlascrete&r and/or &dCleanroom Glass&r you will make.
We'll start you off with a 5x5x5 Cleanroom, but you should upgrade its size when you start feeling cramped.
&6This quest unlocks a new tutorial on the Cleanroom in the &lTips and Tricks&r&6 tab - check it out to learn more!&r
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o The Cleanroom comes from GregTech 5, but as is often the case, the GT5 implementation is much more punishing. The recipes would run without regard to cleanliness, but had a % chance of completion equal to the cleanliness of the Cleanroom. This caused a lot of accidental voiding.
&oFurthermore, if the Cleanroom had a maintenance issue, the cleanliness would cap out at 90%, which means 10% of items would be voided.
&oThe GTCEu Cleanroom will &6never void&f recipe outputs.
They put me in a room... a clean room

The Cleanroom

The &3Large Chemical Reactor (LCR)&r is a multiblock &3Chemical Reactor&r with more input/output slots. Its Teflon casings allow it to process extra recipes.
All &dOverclocks&r in the &3LCR&r are &6100% efficient&r (known as Perfect overclocks); each overclock will &5quadruple the speed&r, as opposed to doubling it.
The &3LCR&r has yet another &6advantage&r. You can use &32 Energy Hatches&r to allow it to run recipes of the &5next tier&r, similar to the &3Electric Blast Furnace&r.
{@pagebreak}
&9Tip:&r Given the amount of LCRs you may end up using, why not try utilising &dwallsharing&r to its full potential?
You could share one 2A (standard) &3Energy Hatch&r between 2 LCRs.
You might want to share &3Input/Output Hatches&r, but make sure each LCR is running the correct recipe.
Keep in mind Maintenance hatches cannot wallshare.
The &3LCR&r can perform some exclusive reactions which allow you to combine multiple normal &3Chemical Reactor&r steps into a &6single step&r. Examples below:

&9-&r &aSulfuric Acid&r
&9-&r &aPhenol&r
&9-&r &aEpichlorohydrin&r (you need it for Epoxy!)
&9-&r &aEpoxy&r

The &3HV Macerator&r finally unlocks more of the slots shown in EMI. With this, the first &9three&r slots are now available. This allows you to receive the &6unique ore Byproduct&r from macerating &dThermal &dCentrifuged Ore&r.

&oThis is a guide on how to automatically route &lall&r&o your Hot Ingots to your Vacuum Freezer while keeping everything automated perfectly fine.&r
{@pagebreak}

&l&9Note:&r If you wish to know more tags for future automation setups, they will display if you press Shift when hovering over an item. For instance, an item tagged with &e&o#forge:plates/copper&r would be filtered as &e&lplates/copper&r.
&9Other Note:&r The Item Tag Filter partially supports &dregex&r. Hover over the info icon for more information.
You already know the drill from the Chemical Bath, so let's get right to the chase.
{@pagebreak}

Install an &aItem Tag Filter&r Cover on the &3Input Bus&r of your &3Vacuum Freezer&r, open it and set to whitelist &e&lhot_ingots&r. The slot is to &dtest&r items to make sure you configured the Filter properly in case you forgot. Drag ingots from EMI!
From here, you now have the option to route either with &9Item Pipes&r or &9AE2&r.
{@pagebreak}
&2With Item Pipes&r, connect the output of your &3EBF(s)&r to the input of your &3Vacuum Freezer&r and the output dump (Chest, Crate, or ME Interface).
You can also have a &dRestrictive Pipe&r in front of the output dump to ensure the Vacuum Freezer will be prioritized.
&2With AE2&r, place a &3ME Storage Bus&r on top of your Cover and set to very &dhigh priority&r. Any hot ingots entering your ME system will automatically be moved into the Vacuum Freezer.
Can we get much smarter? Apparently so
300IQ

To get your grubby hands on some Titanium, &aRutile&r must first be reduced to &aTitanium Tetrachloride&r in an &3HV Chemical Reactor&r, then reduced again in an &3EBF&r with &dMagnesium&r to finally arrive at Titanium.

The &dCarbon&r, &dChlorine&r, &dOxygen&r, and &dMagnesium&r used in the process can be &6perfectly recovered&r from the byproduct &dCarbon Monoxide&r and &dMagnesium Chloride&r with no loss. If you set up a system to recover them, &athe only material&r that you'll need to provide for Titanium is &dRutile&r!
{@pagebreak}

&aTitanium Tetrachloride&r also acts as a catalyst in the production of plastics. A touch of &aTiCl₄&r in the polymerisation process can increase the polymer yield to &6133%&r&r. Naturally, this is completely optional.

Time to say goodbye to your &4Primitive Water Pumps&r. They've done you proud.
Place this on the side of a machine to give it &616 buckets&o&r&r of Water every second!
Later on in &5EV&r, you can use these to craft Infinite Water Cells for your AE2 network.
Truly revolutionary - water

&aPolytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)&r is a &7Carbon&r-&bFluorine&r polymer. Similarly to PVC, PTFE can be used to increase the yield of Plastic Circuit Boards and other crafts. Presently, it is used to make the walls of &3Large Chemical Reactors&r.
&3Chlorine&r is required in the process, which is fully recycled if you electrolyze the &aHydrochloric Acid&r waste.
&bFluorine&r will also be used in the &aUranium&r and &7Naquadah&r refinement processes.
&9Tip:&r From this point onwards, you should be solidifying Polymers as &dBar&r (Ingot) form, as they can easily be shaped to whichever form you will need using the &3Extruder&r.

The &3Power Substation&r is a multiblock power storage system. Fill it with &a2-18 layers&r of assorted &9Capacitor Blocks&r to increase its storage. Each layer must be full of capacitors, and you can use Empty Capacitors to fill unused spaces.
&9Capacitors&r also hold significantly more energy than the batteries used to make them. In the &3Power Substation&r, &9Capacitors&r can be mixed, so they do not all have to be the same tier.
At &1IV&r, you can make &5EV&r and/or &1IV&r Capacitors.
{@pagebreak}
Energy can be inputted with regular Energy Hatches, and output with regular Dynamo Hatches.
You can also use &9Substation Hatches&r to transmit many more amps. These hatches only work in Substations, and do not work in regular multiblocks.

Faster Ore Processing only at the cost of this &3Macerator&r! A must have.

And now, it's finally time for mass ore processing automation.

&oShadow of Greg's &3Fusion Reactor&f (which is now GTCEu's Fusion Reactor) comes with an added mechanic called &4Heat&f.
&oWhen the reactor is running, the &9EU to start&f is converted to &4Heat&f. That Heat is preserved until the Reactor goes idle, at which point it will slowly go down.
&oNext time a recipe is found, it will use all possible Heat and deduct it from the &9EU to start&f, allowing you to save Energy for short pauses.

&oThe &3Fusion Reactor I&f can only run recipes up to a required EU of 160 MEU to start. It will also overclock up to &dLuV&f at best, even if you upgrade to ZPM Hatches, so don't stress over attempting this.
To save on &3Fusion Casings&r, fit Input/Output Hatches wherever you can (as displayed in the structure).

The &bFusion Reactor&r will pick a free Output Hatch from the many that are available. In order to "&6force&r" the Reactor to use a particular Output Hatch, you can always &alock all of the hatches&r to an irrelevant fluid (we usually use &9Water&r).

The chances you are having TPS issues playing this modpack are slim - this Quest is more suited for late game bases with GregTech and AE2.
{@pagebreak}
Things to&c avoid&r with AE2:
&9-&r ME Import and Export Buses on large networks. Use ME Interfaces instead.
&9-&r Crafting Cards to passively do large requests.
&9-&r Recursive insertion and/or extraction through sub-networks. If you use sub-networks, make them do very specific things rather than interacting with another AE2 network.
{@pagebreak}
Things to &cavoid&r with GregTech (GTCEu has received a lot of improvements over GTCE, but it is possible to destroy your TPS, as with any mod):
&9-&r Many EU Producers connected to many EU Consumers in the same line. Instead, use a Diode or Battery Buffer to separate your line of generators to your line of machines.
&9-&r Large amounts of Fluid Pipes. They are &onot&r laggy individually, but they can add up if you have thousands of them.
&9-&r Big Item Pipe networks. Small networks are better, to reduce the number of iterations over inventories.
If you run the command &9/forge tps&r, you will be given the current &4TPS&r and the &4tick time&r in milliseconds.
If the tick time exceeds 50ms, the server is under too much load, and won't be able to keep up with a steady 20 TPS.
Any machine will add up to the tick time, but don't be too scared of adding machines. Most of the lag usually comes from things that are unoptimized.
{@pagebreak}
Things to &cavoid&r in general:
&9-&r Entities are pretty bad. Ground items or mob entities should be kept as low as possible at any given time. Thankfully, this shouldn't be an issue in this modpack.

The &3Fisher&r catches fish from Water. It requires a 5x5 area of Water directly below to operate. It uses the same loot table as normal Fishing, so it can catch things like &dEnchanted Books&r. Each operation consumes 1 String and EU equivalent to its tier (32 for &7LV&r, etc.) That's about it.
&eFish Oil&r can be extracted from Fish, which can be used for &6Bio Diesel&r.
Get &eany&r tier Fisher to complete this quest. (They only go up to &5EV&r. If you foresee needing enough Fish to justify an &1IV&r or higher Fisher, make a feature request on our GitHub or Discord.)
Women want me, fish fear me
Fisher
Fishing 50
The &3Chemical Reactor&r will be required for &la lot&r of recipes.

Let's give it a spin - why don't we use your freshly made Chemical Reactor to unlock a new, &6better recipe for Rubber&r? Rubber is &dunusable&r as a Fluid, so you will need to make another machine to process it further.
{@pagebreak}
You can't make Rubber using the Chemical Reactor alone, so here are some &aother machines&r you might want to aim for:
A &3Solidifier&r is useful to solidify your Rubber directly into &aRubber Sheets&r. You'll want these moving forward.
You could then make use of an &3Assembler&r to use your molten Rubber for &aCables&r. This isn't important for Tin Cables, but better cables will &eneed&r to be made in the Assembler.
&eNote:&r Submit a fluid by having it stored in a &lbucket&r in your inventory. Sorry - it's an FTB Quests quirk.
Chemistry for dummies
Basic Chemical Reactor

When placed on a machine, Robot Arms are a more configurable version of a Conveyor Module. They allow you to transfer items in specific batches, at specific rates, or keep a certain amount of items stocked.
Practical uses for the Robot Arm will be explained in future Quests as a tutorial.
&9Note:&r The functionalities provided by the Robot Arm work &lonly&r if it is &lrequired&r to perform the operation.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o GregTech 5 had blocks such as the Buffer, Filter and Type Filter to allow fine control over items. In GTCE it's all been replaced by the almighty Robot Arm and various Filter Covers. Much more compact!
You're going to hate making these
&aBatteries&r can be put into the energy slot at the bottom middle of machine GUIs, or in a &3Battery Buffer&r.
When inside your inventory, they can be sneak-right-clicked to allow the batteries to &dcharge&r your EU items.

&7LV&r, &bMV&r, and &6HV&r Batteries come in three forms, allowing you to pick the one you find the best depending on materials you have. &dLithium&r has the best capacity, followed by &dCadmium&r, then &dSodium&r.
Our recommendation? Find a Salt vein, and either &aelectrolyze Salt&r for &dSodium&r, or &awash crushed Lepidolite&r for &dLithium&r.
Get &eany&r &aBattery&r to complete this quest.
Batteries for storing energy!
Any LV Battery
Batteries!
&dSneak right-click&r when in hand to activate your Magnet. Do it again to deactivate. The battery capacity of your magnet depends on the battery used to craft it.
If you're worried about getting overwhelmed by Cobblestone or Netherrack, use the trash can from FTB Utilities (top left corner of your inventory) to void them

&9Note:&r The magnet has a whitelist filter turned on by default (in other words, it's not going to pick anything up.) Right-click the magnet to tinker with the item filter settings. There's even a &ctag filter&r - you could, for example, whitelist only &braw ores&r!
Why can't these items I mine behave and enter my inventory!?
Magnet
The &3Packager&r compresses &aTiny Dusts&r and &aSmall Dusts&r into &afull Dusts&r, which can be compressed further into Ingots.
It can also work in reverse, change between sizes of Wires, and much more...
Unpacking Cables back into Wires and Rubber will be &every useful&r once you rewire your Energy Network.
{@pagebreak}

&oYeah, we know...&r the 3x3 compacting recipes don't seem useful, because you can just use a Crafting Table. We urge you to consider the utility of this machine when used for &9automation&r purposes.
For an &9automated&r Dust setup, route &aTiny Dusts&r into a buffer inventory (a chest will do) placed next to your &3Packager&r.
Next place a &3Robot Arm&r and configure it to "&dImport&r", and "&dSupply Exact 9&r". Finally, let the Machine auto-output on another side.
&l&3Lore:&r&o In GTCE, the reverse operation required a separate machine - the Unpackager.
Look who's packing
Basic Packer
ftbquests.chapter.lv__low_voltage.quest4: Many materials going forward cannot be smelted directly from any Ores! They are instead obtained as byproducts from processing of other ores. Gallium and Arsenic are &4among&r these materials.
{@pagebreak}
For &dGallium&r, you may, ranged from worst to best (compromising difficulty and yields):
&9- &3Electrolyze &aSphalerite&r for a low chance of dust. Note that you lose out on direct smelting value.
&9-&r Put &aCrushed Bauxite&r in the &3Chemical Bath&r. Note that this requires &9Sodium Persulfate&r.
&9-&r Obtain it as a Byproduct of &aSphalerite&r Ore Processing in the &3Thermal Centrifuge&r or &3Centrifuge&r.
For &dArsenic&r, you will have to mine and &3centrifuge&r &aRealgar&r.
I hate byproducts, they're awesome
Gallium Arsenide
&3Concrete&r and &3Studs&r are two decorative block families added that increse your speed when walking on them, with &3Concrete&r increasing your speed more.
Get &9either&r of them to complete this quest.
Subsonic!
Blocks
Gotta go fast
As mentioned in the previous quest, electrolyse the &1Sapphire Dust&r to get your &bAluminium Dust&r.
Now all you need is an EBF! If you haven't started to work towards one, move to the right on this quest page and you'll end up there.
Aluminium, not "Aluminum"
Aluminium Dust
&6Superconductors&r are special Wires available for each Voltage tier. They don't come with a Cable counterpart, but that isn't necessary, as they have absolutely &6zero cable loss&r.
They also won't damage you when you touch them. This makes them the best choice for wiring, if not a little expensive in comparison to the other wires.
If you weren't already enamoured, the 1x variant also covers 2 Amps. Isn't that nice?
Now is a good time to replace your crappy &aTin Cables&r. Recycle them in the &3Packager&r to recover both the Tin and Rubber used to craft them.
{@pagebreak}
Can't figure out how to make some of these? Here's a hint - &eTricalcium Phosphate&r and &2Pyrolusite&r ought to help.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o No version of GregTech has had actual Superconductors for &7LV&f up until Gregicality and GTCEu, though some modpacks had lossless cables.
We aren't losing a single Amp more
LV Superconductor
The &aFluid Regulator&r is sort of the equivalent to a &9Robot Arm&r for Fluids.
It can transfer fluids, but has two useful modes:
&9-&r &dSupply Exact&r will transfer the amount of specified Fluid per tick if available. No more, no less.
&9-&r &dKeep Exact&r will make sure the exact amount of Fluid in the attached machine is being kept.
A cover!
ftbquests.chapter.lv__low_voltage.quest5: &lOutside of Ore Processing:&r
Oh boy, what can't this machine do? Decomposition recipes to separate dust types, separating air, do your taxes, and many others...
The list is too long! Let's just say &cyou need the Centrifuge&r.
{@pagebreak}
&lFor Ore Processing:&r

This takes &aImpure Dust&r or &aPurified Dust&r and turns them into clean Dust, plus an added tiny Dust &6Byproduct&r. This is outside of the optimal chain for Byproducts, but this is also the cheapest Ore Processing machine of the presented array to run and to setup on a small scale.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o In base GTCE, this was objectively the strongest Ore Processing machine as it was fairly easy to use, and gave three tiny dusts, just like the Ore Washer or the Thermal Centrifuge. We tuned it down in favor of diversity.
Jack of Many Trades
Basic Centrifuge
Build this machine next to your &3Chemical Reactor&r to automatically solidify Rubber into &aRubber Sheets&r.
You can make your Chemical Reactor auto-output if you &dwrench&r the side of your &3Chemical Reactor&r and enable Fluid &9auto-output&r.
There will be more Fluids to solidify, so you may re-purpose your &3Fluid Solidifier&r when not crafting Rubber - or make a second one!
The Fluid Solidifier solidifies...
Basic Fluid Solidifier
This machine combines washing for simple automation, but also advanced and precise washing for byproducts.
Washing a &aCrushed Ore&r will grant a &aPurified Ore&r which can be refined further, some useless stone, and more importantly, the first &6Byproduct&r!
Any Ore will give at &9minimum 2/3rd of a Dust&r of this Byproduct through washing. Prioritize this step the most.
Using Distilled Water over Water cuts recipe duration in half, but it's also more difficult to produce.
Wash that mouth out
Basic Ore Washing Plant
This is a &4meme&r quest - check the recipe requirement for the teddy.
Yes... this will take you an entire year to craft in an &7LV&r Compressor. How long would this take you to craft when overclocked to the highest possible value?
&7Definitely don't worry about making this now... take the hint and wait for a heavy overclock.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o The main developer of this pack spent far too long fixing the model files to customise this thing.&7.&8. If you're wondering why there's a random Pokemon doll, it's my Minecraft skin!
Got enough time on your hands?
And they say GregTech is grindy...
By clicking the &6Circuit Configuration Slot&r in machines, you can create a &bghost Programmed Circuit&r.
This is a "&7fake circuit&r" that allows you to select a configuration for recipes. There's no need to spend your circuits crafting &bProgrammed Circuits&r anymore.
The purpose of this ghost circuit is to prevent &drecipe clashes&r - for example, the same Wiremill can produce wires of different thicknesses, with the same material!
&dElectric Machines&r and &dItem Input Buses&r will have a Ghost Circuit Slot.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o This feature is originally from GTNH.
Don't want to spend your circuits to select recipes?
Programmed Circuits
Unfortunately, this is only an &lEmpty&r Spray Can, which you have to fill with Chemical Dye before using.
&aSpray Cans&r do not provide any functionality involving machines, but can be quite &bvisually appealing and useful&r!

Any &7(or almost any)&r GregTech tile entity &7(machine, pipe, cable...)&r can be &6painted&r to one of the 16 colors of your choosing. This is great for screenshots, or to separate different setups for convenience in a Multiplayer base. They also help with distinguishing between pipelines and cables.
Holding the &aSpray Can&r in the offhand will automatically paint any block you place.
Time for server tag wars
Spray Can
&8Wait, we're not in the Steam Age anymore!

The reason we didn't present &7LV&r versions of &6Steam&r machines is because they are &4NOT&r required. You might not want to invest into an upgrade that does next to nothing. Except for &othis one&r specifically, because it's a big improvement over the &6Steam Age&r.

The &3Basic Extractor&r gains Fluid capabilities, which enables &aFluid Extraction&r. Use it to melt Rubber that you previously solidified, to &dmelt Soldering Alloy&r for your circuits, and to &dmelt Red Alloy&r for the &6best Vacuum Tube recipe&r in the &3Assembler&r!
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o Did you notice this machine doubles as both an Extractor and a Fluid Extractor? The two of them were separate machines in previous versions of GregTech.
The Steam Extractor extracts...
ftbquests.chapter.lv__low_voltage.quest6: The &3Arc Furnace&r uses a lil' bit of &9Oxygen&r to smelt items in a different fashion than Furnaces.
You can use it to make easier &aWrought Iron&r, double your &aGlass&r, and gain access to &aAnnealed Copper&r.
It can also recycle various components and machines back to their original material.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o Previous versions had both the Arc Furnace and the &bPlasma Arc Furnace&f. In that case, why not use one machine for both? Well, that's exactly what we thought - but we ultimately decided to remove one of the two &bplasma&f recipes. And then the other &bplasma&f recipe.
&oIn short, the &bPlasma Arc Furnace&f is &4gone&f. RIP.
Here lies Plasma Furnace

While this is an extremely &9important&r machine for progression, this will &9&lnot help you immediately&r as it is &cexpensive.&r Most of the recipes you will want to pursue require &cfluids&r. Set up a little bit more infrastructure before rushing this.
&l&3Lore:&r&o Back in the days of GregTech 2, the Assembling Machine only had two slots, and was only really used for alternate Circuit and Hull recipes.
With that out of the way, the &3Assembler&r is crucial to gameplay. Consider it as important as a Crafting Table, except... well, it's a machine, duh.
We as "modpack developers" also love to use this to include all sorts of custom recipes - and speaking of custom recipes, the Assembler now unlocks &dApplied Energistics 2&r!
{@pagebreak}
Once you have enough infrastructure you will be able to make use of better recipes for:
&9-&r &6Vacuum Tubes&r, giving over double the previous yield
&9-&r &6Resistors&r, granting 4 resistors per craft!
&9-&r &6Circuit Boards&r, greatly reducing copper used
Wahoo!
Assemblers, Avenge!
By itself, the Battery Buffer does nothing. However, if you place batteries inside its internal storage, it will act as a power buffer.
The &3Battery Buffer&r handles &9two Amps in&r, and &9one Amp out&r, &dper Battery&r. The output side has the dot, and all other sides are used as inputs.

Our recommendation is to have your generators input energy into it, and power your machines from the output side. This is because the Battery Buffers will demand many Amps of power when it charges, and this could prevent you from using your other machines if it's set up in a way where it can divert power from your other machines to itself.
&6It'll also charge &lboth&r EU and RF Tools inside it&r.
This is a must have if you don't have unlimited power at hand. Get &eany&r &7LV&r Battery Buffer to finish the quest. However, the 16 slots variant is likely overkill at this stage.
{@pagebreak}
&9Note:&r Don't loop your lossy Cables back to your Battery Buffer! If you think about it, you'll just end up voiding energy.

&l&3Lore:&r&o To be frank with you, the GTCE Battery Buffer was... mediocre. It's been reworked in GTCEu to provide a mix between GT5 and GTCE's functionality. Energy now splits evenly across all batteries!
LV Battery Buffer
Battery Buffer
&7LV&r will require you to craft a lot of different machines! You may also find it useful to have multiple of the same machine, set to different programmed circuit values.
Here's a friendly tip if you're struggling to set goals: pick an item in a later quest and go backwards from there.

With that in mind... why don't we start with a &5Fusion Reactor&r? Never mind, slightly too ambitious - let's check a closer goal instead. Ah, yes, the &3Electric Blast Furnace&r - the main "end goal" of &7LV&r - should be a good target.
The EBF is &aexpensive&r, which is why you should initially focus on machines to make components and materials cheaper. We'll do our best to guide you in the right direction with these quests.
Other important goals are crafting the &3LV Assembler&r and making your first &aMV Circuits&r.
Too many options, too little time!
I... might have some sense of direction now
Progressing Through LV
All machines typically have one &7Front Face&r, and one &9Output Face&r.
The &7Front Face&r should be obvious.\nThe &9Output Face&r is the face with a dot or hole on it. By default, this is at the back of the machine as you place it.

Machines can &aauto-output&r through their output face. To enable auto-output, click the appropriate button in the GUI. Fluid and item auto-outputs are toggled separately. Further control over outputs can be achieved with &dFilters&r and &dCovers&r, which are explained in the quest to the upper left of this one.
{@pagebreak}
Right-clicking a machine with a &5Wrench&r changes the output side, and shift-right-clicking changes the front side. Keep in mind that the front side &ccannot&r also be the output side!

By default, items and fluids cannot be inserted through the output side, but this can be toggled with a &5Screwdriver&r. Either right-click the output face directly, or shift-right-click on the grid corresponding to the side of the output.

There are unique machines that do not process recipes, such as the &3Pump&r, &3Miner&r, &3Fisher&r, &3Item Collector&r, etc. These machines will output on their &7Front Face&r (which is still marked as a dot).
Let's learn.
Hmm, how interesting!
Machine Auto-Output Behaviour
Make some Battery Alloy, used for Battery Hulls.
Antimony is found in the &cNether&r, so don't forget to check its Ore Tab.
&9Note:&r This quest does &lnot&r contain functional Batteries - head downwards for that.
Batteries are great!
Any #forge:ingots/battery_alloy
Battery Preparations!
The &3Steam Turbine&r is the only Generator you can realistically use in &7LV&r. &2Later, you'll unlock more interesting Power options&r, such as natural gases or petrols.
When provided Steam, the turbine will output EU at a ratio of &d2 Steam = 1 EU&r.
&6This quest unlocks two new tutorials on Electricity and Cables in the &lTips and Tricks&r&6 tab - check them out to learn more!&r
{@pagebreak}

If you're using a single &3Steam Turbine&r, you only need &a1x Tin Cables&r. On the other hand, if you upgrade to &32 Steam Turbines&r, you should use &a2x Tin Cables&r - else they may end up &cburning&r.
This is because of the &9Amperage&r mechanic... but that will be explained later so you can enjoy playing. Don't worry!
You must construct more turbines
Electricity Generation
ftbquests.chapter.lv__low_voltage.quest7: This quest is a light look over the &dfull scale of regular Ore Processing&r. Why "regular"? Some ores require special treatment, but that's a topic for much later. Oh no, we're already getting carried away!
Each quest surrounding this one gives a different machine that has some involvement in Ore Processing.

&cNote:&r Don't get too preoccupied with Ore Processing! It's very slow at this point, and somewhat power hungry. Around 90% of ores are not important enough to warrant going out of your way to obtain their byproducts. &7That's a legitimate stat, by the way.&r
You can't escape Greg...
I agree to lose my sanity
What is this Mess?: Part Two
&9Drills&r are electric tools which come in different tiers. The &7LV&r Drill is quite good: mining a 3x3x1 area. Higher-tier drills can mine 3x3x3, 5x5x5, and up to 9x9x9 to make huge holes!
This suggested drill is with a Diamond tip, which might be the best material for it right now.
&9Note 1:&r All Electric Tools have a lot more durability than indicated, as they use Energy to prevent damage from being applied! On top of that, they can be enchanted as Pickaxes can.
&9Note 2:&r Drills can now be configured to different ranges, not just the maximum or a single block.
&9Note 3:&r You can now craft electric versions of other tools too! Hooray for less Wire Cutter crafting!
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o Up until GTCEu, Electric tools required Stainless Steel, which locked players out of experiencing their glory until &6HV&f!
We Drill Now? We Drill Now.
Oh Yeah, we Drillin'
&aSoldering Alloy&r is used solely as a &9Fluid&r, and in most cases is &dinterchangeable&r in circuit recipes as a cheaper alternative to Tin&r.
The choice is yours. Save more materials? Make Soldering Alloy. Spend less time crafting materials? Tin is the way to go.
I got soul but I'm not a solder
Soldering Alloy
Well... can you show us an &bMV&r Circuit as well?
&aAluminium&r is the main ingredient for &bMV&r machinery. Check &8aa&7aa&raall the way to the other side for the &2Sapphire Quest&r if you haven't acquired any &aAluminium Dust&r yet.
Once you setup an &3MV Electrolyzer&r, you can get &aAluminium&r through many other ores. All of this quest's rewards bear &aAluminium&r, so keep an eye out for them when mining.
The process of smelting Aluminium can be cut down by about a third with &9Nitrogen&r, which is obtained by centrifuging &9Air&r from a &3Gas Collector&r.
&6You will still need MV Circuits in order to make MV machines!&r
We're basically in MV now, right?

The &3Thermal Centrifuge&r is the most energy hungry out of the Ore Processing machines. It takes &aCrushed Ore&r or &aPurified Ore&r to give a different &6Byproduct&r from the &3Ore Washer&r, but at the same rate.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o The GT5 Thermal Centrifuge required 48 EU/t to run. Yes, this may be above 32 EU/t, but GT5 had &dspecial mechanics&f where certain machines such as this one could accept more than 1 Amp.

&oIn GTCE, the Thermal Centrifuge was changed to only work at &bMV&f with 60EU/t recipes. Let's be completely honest with you... what a &4complete waste of time&f! Never worth it. Thankfully, we've buffed the machine to be much more relevant.
No, not THAT kind of Thermal
Basic Thermal Centrifuge

The Sifter sifts &dGem type&r &aPurified Ores&r to find &aExquisite&r and &aFlawless&r Gems, which can be cut into normal Gems. It also finds &aPurified Dusts&r of that gem. Overall, this gives a &6higher yield&r than other means.
A small amount of &dFlawless Emeralds&r will be required in &bMV&r, and running ores in &3Sifting Machine&r is how you obtain these.

&9Note:&r If you crushed Gem Ores (such as Diamond), it is critical you use this machine to recover the actual gems in non dust form. However, this is a rather slow process, so you may want to smelt this type of ore directly into the Gem.
You're as Exquisite as the gems you sift!
This questline serves as a quick guide to &9GregTech Amperage&r. As for &dVoltage&r mechanics, we'll go over those once you reach &bMV&r.
&6&lTL;DR:&r For safety, match the Amperage limit of your Cables with the max amount of Amps provided by your Energy Producers.
&6This quest unlocks a new tutorial on Amperage in the &lTips and Tricks&r&6 tab - check it out to learn more!&r
Amps and You: a how-to
But what are Amps?
Don't let EMI fool you... there's only one possible recipe right now for this Primitive Diode.
Diodes have a infamously &4nasty recipe&r, but they will become cheaper and more convenient once you can obtain &ePolyethylene&r.
This is required for &dMV Circuits&r.
Don't be swayed by EMI!
Crates are flat upgrades to Chests. A single block space that stores more items - what more could you ask for?
Where they shine is the fact that they &6accept Covers&r, making them perfect candidates for buffers in automation.
Earlygame buffering
GregTech Storage
Free nitro?
Nitrogen
ftbquests.chapter.lv__low_voltage.subtit: Tame electricity and make your first machines
ftbquests.chapter.lv__low_voltage.title: &7LV&r - Low Voltage
ftbquests.chapter.multiblock_dilemma.sub: A handy reference of all the multiblocks
ftbquests.chapter.mv__medium_voltage.que: &aBenzene&r is a &9Gas Fuel&r. To skip some frustration, let's check out the two best ways to obtain it.

The first option is typically &dWood based&r. Put Logs in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r for &9Wood Tar&r. The Charcoal you obtain can then be processed in &3Extractors&r for even more &9Wood Tar&r, which you &3distill&r for &aBenzene&r.
Your second option is &dHeavy Oil based&r. Put Heavy Oil in a &3Distillery&r for &9Heavy Fuel&r, which you &aseverely steam-crack&r and &3distill&r again for &aBenzene&r.
{@pagebreak}
For information on how to process Oil, check the Light Fuel and Naphtha Quests.
In general, it is better to prioritize placing down more machines (&dparallelisation&r) over overclocking the recipes. That way, you end up losing less energy processing the resources.

&aBenzene&r is burned in a &3Gas Turbine&r. This power source starts weaker than its &eDiesel&r cousin, but gets a big boost when refined to &6Nitrobenzene&r in &6HV&r. Ultimately, your power source is your choice.
In the end, it's always Benzene
The Church of Benzene
Heavy Fuel can be obtained from many sources, but your best bet is distilling it from &eHeavy Oil&r.
You could just burn it in a combustion generator now for &9Power&r, but there's something even greater... check the Quest to the left.
Things are getting really Heavy around here...
Heavy Fuel
It's quite the investment to own a &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r, but it is &oby far&r the most prominent &6source of Oil&r.
&lWhat you can find in the &2Overworld&r&l:&r
&9Oil:&r richer in &aLight Fuel&r, the most appreciated variant.
&9Light Oil:&r richer in &aRefinery Gas&r, usable for power.
&9Heavy Oil:&r richer in &aHeavy Fuel&r, which has uses that are more niche.
&9Raw Oil:&r richer in &aNaphtha&r, the best source of the early-game oil products.
&9Natural Gas:&r grants &aRefinery Gas&r with no distillation required.
&l&9Salt Water:&r grants &aSodium&r and &aChlorine&r, useful later.
{@pagebreak}
&lWhat you can find in the &cNether&r&l:&r
&9Natural Gas:&r grants &aRefinery Gas&r but with higher yield than the Overworld vein.
It pumps fluids from underneath Bedrock itself. Note that the fluids aren't actually there, instead being simulated.
&9Lava:&r hopefully, you know what this is.
When starting out, you may have to tap randomly until you find something you like. Remember that whatever you pump could also be used to refuel your Fluid Rig.
Fluid veins are stored within &cchunk-sized regions&r. Each vein has a different fluid, but they are mostly types of Oil.
You can't carry out prospecting for fluid veins &oyet&r - this will come at &6HV&r.
{@pagebreak}
Each vein generates with a different base yield. This is typically between &d150L&r to &d300L per second&r.
When drained, fluid veins will slowly deplete. This will cause the fluid yield to decrease over time until it reaches its depletion yield. At that point, you should move the Rig to a different vein.

A &3Basic Fluid Drilling Rig&r will last for 100,000 operations (with 1 second per operation) until depletion. This is enough for &6well over 10,000&r buckets of Oil. Higher tier Rigs will massively increase the yield, while also decreasing the depletion rate.
{@pagebreak}
Fluid Drilling Rigs in CEu!
Fluid Drilling Rigs
Get any kind of &3Pump&r, place it above an Oil spout and... give it some power.
Oil can also be refined in the form of &aLight Fuel&r, &aDiesel&r or even &aGasoline&r, which are excellent power options.
If you chose this path, you should use it for both Power and Ethylene.
Oil spouts are a &6great starting point&r - they will tide you over until you unlock Fluid Drilling Rigs.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o Oil geysers were originally from Buildcraft. If you played a GregTech 5 modpack &cwithout&f Buildcraft, you needed to use the Fluid Rig and tap randomly to try and get lucky, or wait until &6HV&f, where prospecting for fluids was available.
Do &cnot&r pump above an Ocean, as the pump will attempt to pull water, resulting in getting the pump stuck. Sorry!
{@pagebreak}

Each Oil deposit can have between &63,000&r and &69,200&r buckets of Oil, which is a LOT! Refining the Oil&r onsite into either &aLight Fuel&r or &aDiesel&r (or both) is perfectly viable. The next few Quests will explain each type's pros and cons.
Store any obtained Oil in &3Drums&r, but you would do yourself a favour to use a &3Super Tank&r as soon as you can make them.

This is a guide on how to automatically route &lall&r your Hot Ingots to your Chemical Bath, while keeping everything automated in tip-top shape.

Connect the output of your &3EBF(s)&r to the input of your &3Chemical Bath&r and the output dump (Chest or Crate).

EMI might look a little overwhelming here, so we'll go through the best path for Sulfuric Acid here.
Making &eSulfuric Acid&r is a three step process. It is used in many important reactions, so you should automate its production ASAP.
{@pagebreak}

To automate it, you will need &3three LV Chemical Reactors&r. We would recommend building a dedicated setup somewhere with &3a single LV Generator&r to power all three machines. You can then spaghetti your pipes to handle input and output &m...or simply use AE2&r.
&9-&r Step 1: React &aSulfur&r with &bOxygen&r to form &aSulfur Dioxide&r.
&9-&r Step 2: React &aSulfur Dioxide&r with more &bOxygen&r to form &aSulfur Trioxide&r.
&9-&r Step 3: React &aSulfur Trioxide&r with &bWater&r to form &eSulfuric Acid&r.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o GregTech 5's Chemical Reactor only had one Fluid slot. To circumvent that, they would do &dcell chemistry&f. The way you would automate Sulfuric Acid was by having one cell travel from machine to machine and then loop back to its starting position. A somewhat fun and interesting automation challenge, but also a chore!

&aDiesel&r is a &dOil-based &9Combustion Fuel&r.

&aDiesel&r is burned in a &3Combustion Generator&r. It can be further refined to &6Cetane-Boosted Diesel&r in &6HV&r. Compared to the other power sources, it is generally more efficient, but a more demanding processing line. If you take the &eOil&r route for &aPolyethylene&r, this can work great with existing infrastructure. Ultimately, the power source you want to use is your choice.
To mix &aLight Fuel&r and &aHeavy Fuel&r, the right ratio for &3Distilleries&r is &63:2&r from &dOil&r or &dRaw Oil&r.
This would necessitate 3 Distilleries for Light Fuel, or 2 Distilleries for Heavy Fuel.
{@pagebreak}
You can cut the amount of &dOil&r required &6drastically&r by using &dHeavy Oil&r for &aHeavy Fuel&r specifically. &dOilsands&r is a great option if you wish to go down this route!
&o(For the math nerds, you go from 8.33 Oil -> 6 Diesel, to 5 Oil + 0.4 Heavy Oil -> 6 Diesel)&r

&eNote:&r Do &cnot attempt&r to put Oil in the &3Distillation Tower&r You might think it's a good idea because it gives both Light Fuel and Heavy Fuel. However, this process requires a lot of overclocking to be worth your time, and you will lose more energy than what the byproducts are worth.
{@pagebreak}
In general, it is better to prioritize placing down more machines (&dparallelisation&r) over overclocking the recipes. That way, you end up losing less energy processing the resources.

Some of the details are repeated from the introduction quest, but we feel like we needed to expand on the explanation if you want to know all the details!
A classic Ore vein is &d7 blocks&r tall, and ores generate in 4 different patterns:
- The &9Top Ore&r generates in the higher 4 layers of the vein.
- The &9Bottom Ore&r generates in the lower 3 layers of the vein.
- The &9Between Ore&r generates in the middle 3 layers of the vein.
- The &9Sporadic Ore&r generates anywhere in the vein. There will be the least amount of this ore in a vein.
The same ore type can be in 2 different generation patterns, such as in Cassiterite veins.
Ready for some "light" reading?
{@pagebreak}
Each vein can contain up to four different ores.

Ore veins generate in a &4Grid&r. Every vein is spaced by 3 chunks from one to another in a cardinal direction. Each vein generates in an individual "pattern" - some are &6round&r, some are &asnakey&r, and others you'll discover for yourself.

They spawn at the &4Center&r of the Chunks which have both their X and Z coordinates be at &b1 plus a multiple of 3&r (-8, -5, -2, 1, 4, 7, ...). You will typically find two veins in the selected chunk - one will be in the Stone layer, and the other vein lays deeper in the Deepslate layer.
However, Ore veins may be deleted by caves, Oil deposits, or from trying to generate above the ground.
{@pagebreak}
It's a good practice to make &dWaypoints&r to every vein you find, and to label their type. You may want to come back to it several times.
You'll be an expert by the time you finish reading this!
Ore Generation

ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest1C: One could define a Subnetwork &7(or "Subnet" for short)&r as any network that isn't part of your main network.
Oh... and if you've re-enabled Channels in this pack, subnetworks only consume a single channel from your main network. What a bargain!

The simplest way to create a Subnet is by attaching an &bME Interface&r to a &aStorage Bus&r. This means that the Storage Bus will treat the Interface as an inventory to be read from - i.e., it'll be able to see &5all of the items&r in the network connected to the Interface.

As your main network will &4not&r be transferred through the Storage Bus, you'll need to give your subnet power from the main network with &6Quartz Fibre&r. Ensure that you don't accidentally connect the two networks with regular cabling.

Question is - how does this &abenefit you&r as a player? The logistics powers made available with subnetworking are immense, so we'll cover a few examples &9in light detail&r. The rest is left as an exercise to the reader!
- A subnet for your ore processing system, which &bautomatically handles&r all the intermediate byproducts without them constantly entering and exiting your main network!
- Really, it's useful to subnet &dlarger processing chains&r such as &ePlatinum processing&r. This way, you can ensure that byproducts can be appropriately recycled, and reduce overhead.

Subnets can be infinitely nested, but as always in &bmodded Minecraft&r, this should be performed in moderation (or even better, avoided), as many levels of nesting can cause &4performance issues&r when calculating the network.
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest22: Nothing special here. Any ores that you don't wash in novelty chemicals simply need to be washed in water with an &dOre Washer&r. You should use Distilled Water, as it cuts the recipe time down by &650%&r. Set up a couple of Distilleries on-site and buffer into an appropriately-sized &aSuper Tank&r.
If you don't care about the byproducts in this section, you can wash the ores in &bregular water&r without a configured circuit to process &225x&r faster, but &4without&r byproducts.
Nah, I'll go with Distilled Water.
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest23: The &3ME Tag Storage Bus&r is crucial to send tagged items to a desired destination. It does what it says in the tin - simply set its filter by clicking on it, then any items that enter your AE2 network that &ematch the programmed Item Tag&r will be sent to the inventory attached to the Bus.
This can be particularly useful in the event that you wish to use a &afiltered subnet&r to process ore.
Remember to set a &5high priority&r if you want to prioritise Ore Processing!
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest2E: Washing ores with Mercury where applicable instead of &3Distilled Water&r grants unique byproducts that may be difficult to obtain in other circumstances. It's usually worth doing this, as Mercury is readily available from centrifuging &cRedstone&r or &4Cinnabar&r &7(and in fact, Mercury is the &lonly&r&7 real usage of Cinnabar!)&r.
These alternate "&bwashing routes&r" will increase your Gold, Silver, and Platinum Group yields significantly!
Simply wash any &6Crushed Ore&r with a Chemical Bath.

ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest38: As mentioned in the main sections of this quest book, this &5Indium setup&r has a limited lifetime, so don't stress over optimising every last detail.
Simply mix &dPurified Galena&r and &eSphalerite&r together with some &aSulfuric Acid&r to obtain &9Indium Concentrate&r, then combine with Aluminium Dust in a Chemical Reactor for your prize!
Getting your first Indium has never been so fun.
I won't get too attached to my Indium setup.
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest3B: We don't need THIS much Cobaltite, right?
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest3C: The default way to deal with ores at this step is usually with the &eThermal Centrifuge&r for its &bexclusive byproduct&r, but check around the above quest to make sure you're not missing something important.
Let's look at what AE2 can do for you!
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest3D: Some Gem ores - namely &cRuby&r, &9Sapphire&r, and &2Green Sapphire&r - can be mixed with Aqua Regia in their crushed form to obtain Slurry.
When electrolysed, the Slurry has some interesting byproducts. Namely, it's one of the few ways to obtain &dTitanium Dust&r without macerating Titanium ingots!
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest42: You'll want to send off the following ores to &aPlatinum Group Processing&r:

Quite the rabbit hole to jump down...
How would I boost my processing power?
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest43: Some stages listed on this page output Small/Tiny Dusts, or Nuggets. These have little use in such a form, so it's never a bad idea to route these into a &dPacker&r to "&7compress&r" them into their full forms.

If you're having problems with the Packer filling up with too few Nuggets and clogging your buffer, then you may want to consider using a &6GregTech Robot Arm&r set to "Supply Exact". Send your Nuggets in 9 at a time, and you can consider this a problem solved!
Call me Amazon delivery driver the way I be packaging
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest46: The Electromagnetic Separator is an interesting machine that skips &6two processing stages&r, but usually returns &2unique&r byproducts that aren't usually too simple to obtain. You'll need to process down pure dusts to use this - so &bmake sure&r you route any desired ores correctly.
You may &bappreciate&r performing this stage of processing on the following ores:
- Bastnasite Ore &7(This is particularly strong for Neodymium!)&r
- Naquadah Ore &7(The Enriched Naquadah byproduct is very powerful!)&r
I'm harnessing the power of magnetism!

Never mind, it's not as bad as I thought.
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest5A: Sodium Persulfate isn't as simple to obtain as Mercury, but you'll probably find yourself making some when crafting Circuit Boards. Set up a &6Chemical Reactor&r/&bElectrolyser&r combo with a Level Emitter attached if you want to keep some in stock, and then you can wash any Crushed Ore with a &aChemical Bath&r.
You'll want to use &3Sodium Persulfate&r when processing:
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest73: Hello! You're probably looking to set up &abasic ore processing&r. This quest line will try to guide you through the necessary motions. As always, it's &6important&r to make the disclaimer that this isn't the only &o"meta"&r way to process your ores - a strong ore processing facility will treat each ore depending on the demands of your &bGregTech&r factory. We emphasise that you shouldn't take this guide as gospel.
From one Ore, a great many dusts shall flow...
ftbquests.chapter.ore_processing.quest79: From now? That's the basics of an &5ore processing setup&r. You can check your filters, make more machines, and generally improve efficiency, but if you've &6loosely&r followed everything on this page, you should be in &bgood stead&r!
&m&7Hopefully, some information here was of use.&r
