They can be found randomly throughout the world from your daily farming activities.
The &6Advanced Wine Keg&r offers more complex but faster winemaking.
It can produce wines far faster than its based version, but requires juice from grapes to speed up the fermentation process.
&oIt can also be automated without the need for Sparkstone.&r
&6Hyper Fertilizer&r is the fastest and most expensive of them all, shortening grow times by 3 days.
It can be used for painfully slow growing crops, or to make quickly growing crops a daily harvest.
&6Lead&r is a sturdy enough material to build trains in your world!
Unlike what you may be used to, trains from Create do not require create progress or power.
More information can be found here.
The &6Ancient Fruit&r is an extremely valuable farmland crop with a long growing time.
Upgrading a &6Seed Maker&r with an &6Ancient Cog&r will give you a chance to get its seed with every harvest.
Cogs of the Ancients
The one thing that stands between you and mining wealth is the &6Skull Cavern Teleporter&r.
As you mine &6Boulders and Ore&r you'll find ropes going down, taking you to more dangerous and rewarding areas.
&cStaying in the Skull Cavern overnight is dangerous.&r
&c&lYou will faint and be sent home if you're inside it past 5:50 AM.&r
Complete the Vault Bundle
Enter the Skull Cavern
The Skull Cavern
During exploration you may have come across a &6Slime Heart&r. These are precious items that can be used to begin Slime Incubating!
To start, right click a &6Slime Incubator&r with the heart.
Slime Incubating
Normally farm animals are picky about their living conditions and food! The &6Witch&r sells ancient magic that can shrink them into a plushie, making it a luxurious home.
Plushies that have been imbued using a &6Sunlit Crystal&r will have special effects
&oBoth the plushie and the animal must be at max affection.&r
The &dMagic Bulb&r is a strange device capable of harnessing the sun.
It will require studying of all three ribbit artifacts to craft.
Ribbit Sun Magic
&dPrismatic Shards&r are the ultimate form of power on Sunlit Valley.
They craft into many of the most powerful items, and have various hidden uses.
They can be found more commonly the lower you go into the Skull Cavern, and can also be received from specific Skills.
The &6Recycled Core&r is a smith's best friend, doubling the output of all &6Recycling Machine&r recipes.
It can be purchased from the &6Trader&r.
&oRecipes similar to hook recycling do not double.&r
The final tier of Sprinkler, the &6Iridium Sprinkler&r has the highest range out of any.
Occasionally in the Skull Cavern you may come across a &6Trial Chamber&r.
These dungeons are full of &6artifacts&r and &6relics&r, and can be found by using a key on a Trial Vault.
Drinking an &6Ominous Bottle&r will give you better drops for fighting stronger mobs from the Trial Spawners.
Find a Trial Chamber
Trial Chambers
The first layer of the Skull Cavern is relatively safe. It contains a variety of overworld ores, and it doesn't present much danger to you.
&oYou should aim to get through this area as fast as possible...&r
Layer I - The Cavern Shallows
The &6Scribe&r can be used to break glass fast and always drop it. It can also be used to create grooves in ice.
Very useful for moving your greenhouse.
The &6Trader&r is willing to move into your town after noticing your work in the Skull Cavern!
Unlike most other shops, money has no value here. You'll need to trade specific items to afford the trader's wares...
Welcoming Carlos
Invite the Trader
Bartering?
&6Ancient Fruits&r take an excrutiatingly long time to grow. It's best to focus on getting more seeds with the first few harvests before jumping into profits.
&6Sparkpods&r are rough otherworldly fruits that can be sourced from the &6Market&r.
They are filled with energy and can be mashed into &6Sparkstone&r using a variety of methods.
Unlike most crops, they are unable to be cultivated using a &6Seed Maker&r...
&6Refined Storage&r systems are convenient, but the limited range can be limiting in some scenarios.
The &6Dimension Card&r will allow you to access your storage from anywhere when placed in a &6Wireless Transmitter&r.
You'll need to make sure your storage system is chunk loaded for this to work. See the Welcome chapter for info on &6Claiming Chunks&r if you don't know how!

Unlocking &6Adventuring Mastery&r allows you to take your beloved pets on grand adventures without the fear of losing them! It also allows more options with enchanting past the skill tree enchantments.
Once unlocked, certain associated items can be bought from the &6Guild&r and &6Witch&r.
Unlock Adventuring Mastery
The &6Needle Bobber&r and &6Net Bobbers&r are two sides of the same coin, making the fishing minigame much more difficult for a huge boost in rewards.
They'll only be useful to rod champion (or a person that's just upgraded their rod a ton).
Needle or Net Bobber
Masterful Bobbers
As you dive deeper into the Skull Cavern, you might encounter something called &dSparkstone&r.
It is a gem filled with intense energy that can be used to power advanced farming equipment for automation.
The Automation Era
Expensive and slow, the &6Crystalarium&r will duplicate any gem or mineral placed inside. The amount of days to complete will depend on the inserted item.
They should be your first goal if you dislike mining for crafting minerals.
Growing Crystals
&6Advanced Wine Kegs&r need juice, empty wine bottles, and their ingredients to work. The juice a given wine needs can be found in the recipe using JEI by hovering over the bar in the middle.
Recipes can use the following juices:
- &cRed&r/&aWhite&r grape juice
- &cCrimson&r/&aWarped&r grape juice
- &eApple Juice&r (made using an Apple Press)
Juices are inserted in the top left slot of the Fermentation Barrel.
Any Fermentation Barrel juice
Juicing up the Wine
The second layer consists of two different ice biomes: the Frozen Caves and Frozen Maelstrom. By now you may have noticed two things:
- Certain mobs only spawn in certain biomes
- Blocks you place in the Skull Cavern don't get destroyed overnight.
Use these facts to your advantage to get lower faster, especially since this layer will start to be a real challenge from mobs...
Layer II - Frozen Depths
The &6Black Opal&r upgrade can be used on a &6Crystalarium&r to let it produce Pristine versions of the mineral or gem grown.
Not only are these more valuable, but they can also be broken down into multiple of the basic versions.
&6Jade&r can be found by mining &6Omni Geode Nodes&r scattered around the caverns. The deeper you descend, the more likely you are to encounter them.
It is a crucial crafting mineral used in a variety of useful farming machines.
IV - Prismatic Farming
ftbquests.chapter.ivi__mechanical_farmin: Gold and Silver alloys into &6Electrum&r. This is primarily an ingredient for upgrading tools and armor.
The tools do more damage the faster you are, while the armor pieces passively make you faster.
The &6Printer&r can be used to duplicate enchanted books with liquid experience.
This can be harvested from items or players using a &6Disenchanter&r.
&6Liquid Hyper Experience&r can be used to increase the level of the enchanted book by I, even past normal limits.
Copying Enchanted Books
A &6Cooking Guide&r allows machines to easily automate the Cooking Pot.
They aren't cheap, but the right farming setup can significantly boost your profits with passive income.
Automated Kitchen
&6Mechanical Drills&r are simple block breakers whos speed depends on the rotation speed provided. They can be used to build large drills to clear land, or for smaller utility automations.
Once crafted, they can be duplicated using a cheaper recipe.
The most important alloy for progression is &6Brass&r. It is a combination of Copper and Zinc, with Iridium Scrap used as a catalyst.
Another important use for &6Silver&r is &6Electron Tubes&r. These small lights help provide signaling logic for smarter devices such as &6Brass Funnels&r.
&6Lead&r is a secondary material needed for heavy machinery.
It can be found in the &6Skull Cavern&r, increasing in frequency the deeper you go.
Cavern Metal I
Completing the &6Boiler Room&r will give you the blueprints for mecahanical power. It will give you the power to automate parts of your farm and easily move items around.
&oCreate is not required for progression.&r
Mechanical Farming
&6Silver&r is another secondary material found in the &6Skull Cavern&r.
It's commonly used in sensitive electronic equipment, and is one of the rarest ores you can find in the cavern.
Cavern Metal II
&6Lead Sheets&r can be processed into &6Sturdy Sheets&r, a stronger material used to make Train related materials.
While Trains aren't strictly required for progression, they can be useful for long range transportation or logistical automation.
Intro to Trains
&6Andesite Alloy&r is a weaker, but more flexible material used for crafting common mechanical parts.
You'll need a lot of it, so it's worth investing in cheaper ways to obtain it.

&6Ender Drawers&r will have the same items available as the drawer linked remotely, no matter the distance. They can be used to transport items easily, but the cost makes them less convenient than they could be.
They can be linked using a Linking Card.
&6Package Frogports&r will attach packages to &6Chain Conveyers&r to transport items across your base.
You'll need a &6Packager&r to turn these items into packages.
&oPonder both of these blocks to learn more about package logistics&r
Package Logistics
Manually harvesting from Worm Farms gets old fast. An &6Auto Worm Farm&r cultivates worms in an automatable way, with the added bonus of not needing any inputs!
It can be used to automate Crab Traps, provided you have an automated way to turn Worms into Crab Trap Bait.
Worm Parade
&6Item Pipes&r transfer items between inventories in easier ways than Mechanical Belts.
You can place them in a line from one inventory to another, then with a Create Wrench &6Shift + Right click&r the pipe that's next to the inventory you want to take items out from.
&oPipes also cannot automate Artisan Machines&r
Get your Strong Allan wrench
Pipes!
Need a bunch of stone blocks for your farm? Look no futher than the &6Mechanical Extruder&r!
It combines liquids on either side into blocks without consuming either one.
Easy Building Blocks
&6Void Motors&r have the same stress capacity and rotation speed as all other Void Motors in their network.
The network can be configured by setting the frequency using any item.
&6Mechanical Crafters&r are automatable Crafting Tables that have a few exclusive recipes.
&oLocometal Boilers take up a large amount of pages in JEI. The second task shows all of the available ones.&r
Mechanical Crafter Crafts
&6Precision Mechanisms&r are technological marvels that act as the "brain" of complex machinery.
&6Gold Coins&r are the perfect size and shape for such device, placed alongside normal cogs on a Silver Sheet.
Delicate Parts
&6Item Pipes&r are handy, but relatively slow to move items around, and don't have the filtering properties of Brass.
The &6Advanced Pipe Upgrade&r can be inserted into an extracting pipe to increase the amount of items moved at once. It also unlocks complex filtering options.
You can also set the destination of items in complex pipe networks using the &6Filter Destination Tool&r.
Placing a &6Tapper&r on an &6Acacia&r tree will yield &6Sap&r the next day.
This can be smelted into &6Rubber&r, a key resource for Create used in Belts, Funnels, and other items.
Industrially Crafted Rubber
&6Void Steel&r is an optional alloy of Iridium and Eye of Ender. It's used to craft machines fueled by ender power for teleportation.
Steel of Ender
&6Powdered Obsidian&r is a byproduct of crushing Obsidian using a pair of &6Crushing Wheels&r. It is the final resource needed for advanced farming machinery.
&oIt can also be used to cut lead, turning Lead Ingots into more Molten Lead than they're originally worth.&r
Sturdy Dust
With so many materials coming from tapping trees, a basic Tapper won't cut it. The &6Auto-Tapper&r is an alternative option, allowing you to pump out the tapped fluid from the bottom of the block.
Tapped fluids need to either be bottled or used directly.
Auto-Tapping
&6Chain Conveyers&r transport rotational energy over longer distances.
They can also be ridden by right clicking with a &6Wrench&r!
Long Distance Power
Items used in the storage and movement of fluids can be crafted from Copper, with Oak Resin as a sealing agent.
Fluid Movement
&6Void Tanks&r have the same fluid available in its tank to all other Void Tanks in their network.
The network can be configured by setting the frequency using any item.
&6Mechanical Saws&r fell trees in a single swoop automatically. They can be used in contraptions to automate the collection of logs.
Once crafted, they can be duplicated using a cheaper recipe.
Have a large train network? Are you on a large server and constantly getting lost with the amount of train stations?
The &6Create Railways Navigator&r can help guide you, automatically planning routes and transfers to your selected destination.
Grape juice in liquid form can be easily put inside of Advanced Wine Kegs using the &6Juice Inserter&r.
Pump liquids in and they will continually provide juice fluids.
Automated Juice Logistics
The &6Bottler&r is a &6Packager&r but for fluids!
It can be attached to a &6Fluid Tank&r and transported in the same way a package can.
Fluid Logistics
&6Windmills&r are slower, and less space efficient than Water Wheels. Their main advantage is looking pretty and requiring less Lead per unit of stress.
The more &6Windmill Sails&r connected to a &6Windmill Bearing&r, the higher the stress output.
Wind Power
The &6Blunderbuss&r is a ranged mechanical firearm intended for hunting monsters and balloons.
It has no charging time, making it perfect for dangerous areas such as the &6Skull Cavern&r.
Not very cottagecore of you...
Mechanical Firepower
To progress further, you'll need to press ingots into sheets using a &6Mechanical Press&r.
Ex-Press-O
&6Mechanical Arms&r are a method for transporting items to multiple inputs and outputs. It's handy for automating specific tasks!
You can see a list of valid targets for it on the left side of the ponder menu.
Mechanical Movement
&6Mechanical Harvesters&r are the ultimate form of crop collecting, allowing you to automate your farm completely.
Once crafted, they can be duplicated using a cheaper recipe.
&6Water Wheels&r are the cheapest form of power crafted from simple materials.
They will move once they hit flowing water, and can be connected to Belts and machines using &6Shafts&r.
First Power
A &6Blaze Burner&r can be filled by right clicking a Blaze or Blaze Spawner with the empty version of it.
It can be placed below a Basin and Mixer and given fuel to craft alloys.
Metal Alloying
&6Mechanical Belts&r can be attached to shafts to move items around when powered. &6Funnels&r can be attached to inventories to allow belts to feed into them.
This is the primary method of moving items around in Create.
Moving Items Around
&6Hypertubes&r are a transportation method that uses rotational power to zoop you around your base.
The &6Entrance Block&r requires rotational power, and two of them can be linked using &6Hypertube Blocks&r using the same rules as train tracks.
Tubular Transport
&6Lead&r and &6Silver&r ingots can be automated using various machines.
&6Silver&r can be produced using &6Alchemical Varnish&r, a renewably farmable fluid.
&6Lead&r can be multiplied using &6Crushed Obsidian&r as an additive.
Skip out on the mining!
Automated Metals
Holding the &6w&r key while hovering over a Create item will let you see detailed information about it.
If something isn't explained in this quest chapter, chances are it's explained with Ponder!
Understood
Hold [&6W&r] to Ponder

ftbquests.chapter.pantry.quest43591809C1: Gold quality crops only. Only &63&r tasks required for bundle completion.
ftbquests.chapter.pantry.quest7CBAF07484: Collecting crops of every season and animal products completes the Pantry. This rewards you with a building containing &648 Greenhouse Glass&r. This valuable material allows crops of any season to grow when the glass is at most 16 blocks above the crop.
You can also choose to just receive the glass itself, if you'd like to build your own greenhouse.
ftbquests.chapter.pantry.title: Pantry
ftbquests.chapter.perfection.quest17064A: You've done absolutely everything there is to offer in &6Society: Sunlit Valley&r. Your farm is the envy of all your neighbors for miles.
You feel empty inside. The &dTrophy of Perfection&r gives you unlimited &dPrismatic Shards&r, but you fail to see the use of them at this point.
ftbquests.chapter.perfection.quest272D92: You've scoured the lands, pillaged the mines, and annoyingly crafted too much food.
Doing this insane task is only part of the way towards having the perfect capitalist empire.
ftbquests.chapter.perfection.quest3E074A: &6Sharestones&r can teleport you to any of the same color. All 4 are needed to attain perfection.
&oYou don't have to read the other Sharestone quests.&r
ftbquests.chapter.perfection.quest45120B: This will likely be your first and easiest stop to attaining perfection, but it's one you cannot skip.
Completing each room has its own rewards and merits.
ftbquests.chapter.perfection.quest5875FF: &6Sharestones&r can teleport you to any of the same color. All 4 are needed to attain perfection.
&oYou don't have to read the other Sharestone quests.&r

ftbquests.chapter.perfection.questA1FA99: Clocking in at &616 million &rcoins, the &6Golden Clock&r is one of the most excruciatingly and unnecessarily expensive items in the game.
It will randomly progress all artisan machines in its 5x5x5 area, centered around the clock.
Not that you really need the money at this point.
ftbquests.chapter.perfection.title: Perfection
ftbquests.chapter.relics.title: Relics
ftbquests.chapter.slimes.title: Slimes
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest100B4D3BEEE: To craft special furniture using the &6Workbench&r, you may need items purchased from a catalog.
These can be bought from a &6Witch&r, and placed in world.
Right click them with &6Coins&r to purchase the crafting items for that furniture set.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest12ED0E637AD: The &6Workbench&r is used for crafting advanced furniture, and blocks from furniture catalogs!
It can be purchased from the &6Blacksmith&r but requires power to operate.
You can burn solid fuel in a generator and connect it to the &6Workbench&r using the &6Electric Wrench&r.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest2193ACEC05C: &6Construction Wands&r allow you to quickly place blocks in a line or surface. Each tier increases durability, and the amount of blocks that can be placed at a time.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest23EFDF37F9B: &6Copycat Blocks&r mimic the texture of the block that you right click with.
This can be used to make stairs, ladders, and other variants of blocks that don't have them (e.g concrete blocks).
This also comes in variants that don't normally exist in Minecraft, such as slopes.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest31F6C5811A7: This chapter lists tools that will help you in building beautiful monuments to capitalism, or quaint farms.
As you can imagine, this is all very optional.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest3A5DF5AD3C5: The &6Magnifying Glass&r shows the working area of certain blocks using right click (Use while crouching if the block has an inventory).
A list of blocks it works on is in the tooltip when holding shift.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest4A4474120CD: The &6DIY Workbench&r crafts any Furniture Catalog item for a very low material cost.
It is also excruciatingly and unnecessarily expensive.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest4EAA3F652AE: The &6Trowel&r places blocks in your hotbar randomly. Good for paving long paths of gravel and stone!
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest54B6F31A66A: The blueprinting system used for the Building Shop can also be used to make your own blueprints!
The &6Scanner&r is used to capture a build.
The &6Tablet&r is used to obtain blueprints to use, or share them with other players.
You can use this to plan builds in creative first!
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest574978CE534: The &6Abacus&r measures the distance between two blocks using right click.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest5837B77D124: &6Gadgets&r can be used to create, exchange, copy, and destroy portions of the world.
They are extremely powerful once you learn how to use them, but the UI may be confusing to newcomers. &6Gadgets for Derps&r explains how to use them in detail.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest6933B95631B: The &6Saw&r cuts logs into any type of wooden item. Useful for building or annoying crafts.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest6C1236C0021: The &6Hammer&r can be used to crush stones into other forms, i.e Stone -> Cobblestone -> Gravel.
The &6Chisel&r turns blocks into their chiseled variants if they exist.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest6DAD35E264D: The &6Wand of Symmetry&r places a mirror in the world that mirrors block placement.
Shift + Right click lets you switch the pattern of placement.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest7BCC4E221CF: &6Frames&r are placeholder blocks for builds that can be quickly replaced by right clicking with a block.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest7D5EB5853F9: The &6Template Manager&r allows you to create and upload schematics! These can be used in other worlds, making it a good way to design buildings in creative and auto-build them in survival.
A &6Copy-Paste&r gadget is needed for this to be useful.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest7E94B1934D0: Tired of hearing your Villagers? Click the "mute" icon in your inventory to open up the &6Extreme Sound Muffler&r GUI, allowing you to mute specific sounds!
ftbquests.chapter.tools.quest86A3F527E1A: The &6Angel Core&r lets you to place blocks in midair using wands.
The &6Destruction Core&r allows you to void blocks the same way that you build them with a wand.
ftbquests.chapter.tools.title: Building Tools
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest12: &6Recall Potions&r are consumables found throughout the world or brewed that will take you home from anywhere.
Usefull early on for exploring without missing 6am!
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest16: The End does not exist in Sunlit Valley.
To craft an &6Elytra&r, you'll need to purchase the expensive parts, and conquer the &6Skull Cavern&r.
Alternatively, an &6Abandoned Farm&r may be repaired to obtain one...
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest1F: &6Maglev rails&r have a much higher maximum speed than normal rails.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest2D: The &6Hearthstone&r is an expensive item with limited uses sold by the &6Witch&r that teleports you to your spawn point from anywhere.
&oYou can get some extra uses out if it by enchanting it with Unbreaking and Mending.&r
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest32: &6Create Railways Navigator&r is an addon that allows for more detailed display of routes and stations.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest3B: &6Small Ships&r allow for traversing the sea quickly. They come in different variants that do better or worse in different ocean biomes.
They have large inventories, and can be mounted with cannons or colored with dye.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest42: Signs can be used to fast travel provided a well made path is between them.
Use a &6Charting Map&r to start and finish charting, adding signs to the path by right clicking them.
You can search &6#path_block&r in JEI to see all the valid path blocks.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest46: Sunlit Valley offers many transportation options for the many types of players.
This page lists all the options for getting around your world.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest53: Create Trains are the ultimate form of railway transport, allowing you to build large custom locomotives with multiple cars.
Tracks and Train gear can be crafted without Create Progression!
They can also be automated using &6Train Schedules&r to transport items and fluids.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest56: The &6Magic Mirror&r teleports you to your spawn point provided it is in range.
The range can be upgraded, and works cross-dimensionally.
It is a reward for completing the &6Crafts Room&r.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest5A: Build highways around your world lined with fields of corn, the true capitalist dream.
The &6Auto Mechanic Table&r can be used to make car parts that are then assembled on an &6Automobile Assembler&r.
Like the description suggests, striking your &6Hearthstone&r with lightning will allow it to be bound to a single location. Outside of that, it has the same exact properties as before.
This can easily be done with a &6Charging Rod&r during a storm.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest69: &6Sharestones&r are sold by the &6Witch&r and can be used to teleport to any of the same color.
Collecting all 4 will let you craft them into a &6Waystone&r which has the same functionality, but lets you teleport to them using scrolls and Warp Stones.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest6E: &6Lightspeed Rails&r have an extremely high max speed, but can't slope or turn.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest71: Teleportation is rare and expensive in this pack, encouraging you to build out your infrastructure at first.
If you cannot live without it, take a look at the "Paving The Road" quest first.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest7B: They can be angled upwards by applying a redstone signal.
There are wooden and maglev variants, with a shorter and longer max length respectively.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.quest7E: A &6Crowbar&r can get you out of a ditch by completely breaking apart your car, but is very much a last resort option.
The &6Car Key&r solves this issue by letting you "park" an Automobility vehicle inside of it.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.questC5: Minecarts are an early-mid game form of transport for both items, players, and mobs.
They are simple but elegant, and have options to make them even faster.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.questE9: Minecarts can be linked using the &6Mob Spring&r or &6Cart Coupling&r.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.questF7: &6Wooden Rails&r are cheaper, with a slower maximum speed.
ftbquests.chapter.transportation.title: Transportation
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest0: The &6Naga Courtyard&r is your first trial. The Naga charges and destroys blocks in its path - keep your distance.
Defeating it yields 6-11 &6Naga Scales&r and a &6Naga Trophy&r. The courtyard has no progression lock.
The Lich's four scepters each have a use: &6Twilight&r (teleport), &6Zombie&r (summon), &6Life Draining&r (drain life) and &6Fortification&r (protect).
They have limited charges. Collect all four as proof of your strength.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest1: Craft Yeti gear from &6Alpha Yeti Fur&r. It comes with Protection II and &6chills attackers&r.
Need more fur? Find another Yeti Cave - every Alpha Yeti drops 6 fur.
Find a &6Trophy Pedestal&r in the &6Dark Forest ruins&r and place a trophy on it to earn a &6title&r.
Placing a trophy also advances Twilight Forest progression.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest3: Craft the &6Naga Scale Tunic&r and &6Naga Scale Leggings&r. They offer solid protection and are the best early armor in the forest.
Craft a &6Magic Map Focus&r: &6Raven Feather&r (dropped by ravens) + &6Torchberries&r (grow on bushes in the forest) + &6Glowstone Dust&r.
Combine 8 paper with the focus into a &6Blank Magic Map&r, then &6right-click&r it inside the Twilight Forest to fill it.
The Magic Map marks every &6landmark structure&r - your first essential tool.
&6Maze Map Focuses&r are found in Labyrinth chests and dropped by &6Minotaurs&r. Combine 8 paper with one into a &6Blank Maze Map&r, then use it inside the Labyrinth.
Deep inside, the &6Minoshroom&r drops Meef and &6Meef Stroganoff&r.
Don't forget the vaults and rare loot hidden in the maze.
The &6Aurora Palace&r stands atop the glacier and unlocks after the Alpha Yeti.
The Snow Queen summons ice crystals and snow guardians - keep moving to dodge the ice.
Defeat her for the &6Snow Queen Trophy&r and &6Aurora Blocks&r.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest4: The &6Quest Ram&r asks for wool in all 16 colors. Feed it every color and it rewards you with the &6Quest Ram Trophy&r and the &6Crumble Horn&r.
It waits for you in the &6Quest Grove&r.
Surround a 2x2 water pool with &6flowers&r (saplings, leaves or crops also work), then throw a &6diamond&r into the water.
Lightning will strike and the portal opens. Portals can only be built in the Overworld; the return portal appears near where you entered.
&oThe Twilight Forest is not peaceful, but its treasures are worth the risk.&r
Build the portal and enter the Twilight Forest
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest5: &6Trolls&r drop &6Magic Beans&r, and more can be found in Troll Garden chests.
Plant a bean on &6Uberous Soil&r and it will grow all the way above the clouds, leading to the cloud castle.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest6: The &6Ore Magnet&r is found in &6Hollow Hill&r chests.
Hold right-click and it pulls a whole ore vein from up to 32 blocks away right to your feet (up to 24 blocks per use).
The Twilight Forest has four basic trees: &6Twilight Oak&r, &6Canopy&r, &6Mangrove&r and &6Darkwood&r. Each has a full wood set.
Chop them with an axe. Watch for &6hollow logs&r - natural ladders you can climb.
The &6Glass Sword&r deals massive damage but shatters after a single hit.
It cannot be crafted - it is only found in &6Aurora Palace&r chests.
Eat the &6Meef Stroganoff&r to adapt to the searing heat of the &6Fire Swamp&r.
Without it the swamp will burn you at every step - this is the only way to the Hydra.
Welcome to the &6Highlands&r. In this version of the Twilight Forest this area is still under development and will be expanded in the future.
Your adventure pauses here - but the trophy wall is still waiting.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest7: Craft the &6Uncrafting Table&r from 8 crafting tables and a &6Maze Map Focus&r.
It uncrafts items, repairs gear and keeps enchantments when recrafting - all at the cost of experience.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest4: &6Giants&r and the &6Giant Miner&r live above the clouds. Defeat the Giant Miner for the &6Giant's Pickaxe&r.
It breaks &6giant blocks&r (giant logs, cobblestone, obsidian) - the very blocks the cloud castle is built from.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest5: Four magic trees grow in the Twilight Forest: &6Time&r, &6Transformation&r, &6Mining&r and &6Sorting&r.
Their cores accelerate time, transform creatures, auto-mine or sort items within a 16-block radius.
The &6Moonworm Queen&r is found in &6Hollow Hill&r and &6Tower&r chests.
Right-click to place a &6Moonworm&r as a light source; left-click to pick it back up.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest6: The &6Troll Caves&r unlock after all three bosses. Find the &6Lamp of Cinders&r deep inside.
Use it to burn away the &6thorn wall&r blocking the way to the Highlands.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest7: Weaken the &6Ur-Ghast&r with the trap, then defeat it and claim its &6Fiery Tears&r.
Now you can craft &6Fiery Ingots&r: Fiery Blood or Tears + an Iron Ingot. Fiery tools &6auto-smelt&r and armor &6burns attackers&r.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest4: Bring every Twilight Forest boss trophy together: Naga, Lich, Minoshroom, Hydra, Knight Phantom, Ur-Ghast, Alpha Yeti and Snow Queen.
Eight trophies - the proof of all your glory in the Twilight Forest.
The &6Lich Tower&r unlocks after the Naga - enforced progression stops you from breaking blocks or opening chests inside until then.
The Lich summons clones and raises shields; break the shields before you can hurt it.
Defeat it for the &6Lich Trophy&r and four scepters. The &6Trophy Pedestal&r inside can display your trophies.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest1: The &6Hydra&r dwells in its lair in the Fire Swamp, spitting fireballs from every head.
Defeat it for the &6Hydra Trophy&r, &6Hydra Chop&r and &6Fiery Blood&r. The chop is best eaten when you are starving.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest5: The &6Goblin Knight Stronghold&r unlocks after the Trophy Pedestal. Defeat every &6Knight Phantom&r to lay them to rest.
Knights drop &6Knightmetal&r for powerful gear, and the stronghold holds rare loot.
Afterwards you can control the &6Carminite mechanisms&r of the &6Dark Tower&r.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest0: &6Transformation Powder&r turns Twilight creatures into their vanilla counterparts, and back again - Bighorn Sheep to Sheep, Boar to Pig.
Found in Hollow Hill, Tower and Graveyard chests. Don't use it on your own mount!
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest2: A &6Ghast Trap&r lies hidden in the &6Dark Tower&r. Gather &6Carminite&r to build and activate it, trapping the &6Ur-Ghast&r in its own device.
The &6Yeti Cave&r unlocks after the Lich. The Alpha Yeti is far stronger than a common Yeti and hurls ice bombs.
Defeat it for &6Alpha Yeti Fur&r and the &6Alpha Yeti Trophy&r.
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.quest5: To set foot on the &6Highlands&r you must first defeat the &6Hydra&r, the &6Snow Queen&r and the &6Ur-Ghast&r - only then will the acid rain above the plateau stop.
Check your trophies and see who is missing.
I have defeated the Hydra, Snow Queen and Ur-Ghast
ftbquests.chapter.twilight_forest.title: V - The Twilight Forest
ftbquests.chapter.vault.quest4B9634D942E: Purchasing the Vault gives you a &6Skull Cavern Teleporter&r, your gateway to obtaining &dPrismatic Shards&r.
Place it down and right click to enter, but be sure to come prepared! Mobs in the Skull Cavern have twice as much health and damage...
&oThe &6Skull Cavern Teleporter&r&o can also be bought from the &6Guild&r&o if it is lost somehow.
ftbquests.chapter.vault.title: Vault
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest1348507: The &6Trader&r offers wares that can only be purchased with items and not money.
The Trader can be invited on the phone after visiting the &6Skull Cavern&r for the first time.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest2A64214: The &6Fisher&r sells fishing rods and addons to upgrade them.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest327B9F8: Once the Community Center is complete, excluding the Abandoned Farm, the &6Witch&r villager will sell you a &6Ribbit Hut&r!
This building houses Ribbits that can use their powerful magic to harvest crops in a large area around it without any upkeep!
This is a large building, requiring a 3x3x3 area of space to place. You can access its inventory from the door block.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest3333879: Some villagers can only be called over the phone! The &6Banker&r can connect you to these as well as any ones you've unlocked.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest3CF0897: The &6Shepherd&r can get you started with animals on your farm, selling &6Animal Feed&r as well as spawn crates of some basic farm animals.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest4633C04: The &6Banker&r sells management tools to make handling your finances easier.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest4865566: The &6Market&r is the most essential supplier of your farm. It stocks seeds, farming, and cooking supplies.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest49477F0: The &6Librarian&r sells equipment for managing your storage, including the &6Refined Storage system&r to digitally store your items.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest499871F: The &6Blacksmith&r sells metals, smithing templates, and &6Geode Busters&r for cracking open geodes.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest52F1DCA: The &6Witch&r has a deep connection with the nature of the valley and sells various expensive and magical goods.
she can be invited after visiting the &6Nether&r for the first time.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest55F17BB: The &6Guild&r will help you on your adventures, selling tools to navigate around the world better.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest664E4A3: The &6Carpenter&r has two shops to browse through:
- &6Invitations&r, which allow you to invite more villagers
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.quest7B2AB58: The &6Barkeeper&r sells food and various multiplayer-oriented items, such as &6Cameras&r and &6Easels&r.
ftbquests.chapter.villagers.questE7AAB1F: The &6Book Fair&r appears at the end of every season (for example, Late Spring).
Skill books that are normally found in the world can be bought for high prices, with some rotating stock every season.

ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest18490F31F: If you're running a server with more than a handful of people that will be on at seperate times, you should change the season length in the configs.
This can be done by changing the &6sub_season_duration&r in &6config/sereneseasons/seasons.toml&r.
Having this value set to 16-20 is recommended on larger severs to prevent someone from grinding out an entire season in one day.
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest238702B12: If you're not familiar with it, the big list of items in your inventory is known as the &6JEI&r or &6EMI&r panel! While hovering on an item:
&6Left Click/Press R&r to view its recipes
&6Right Click/Press U&r to view its uses
Be sure to check each tab on the top of the recipe, this modpack has many different ways to obtain every item.
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest09E4CDC17: A demo quest added by script to demonstrate FTB quest SNBT structure and translation keys.
Submit 4 bread to complete. A currency reward is granted on completion.
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest25305BECA: Due to the complex world generation of the Skull Cavern, we suggest pre-generating the dimension using Chunky! To do so, run the following commands:
For additional info on chunky, run &6/chunky help&r
&oIt's best to do this when nobody is online for performance reasons&r
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest257779399: Teleportation does exist, however you will have to invest massive amounts of cash to buy it.
Alternatively, you can build out a network of roads and teleport between them using signs.
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest2B6877708: Where farming meets lightly industrialized capitalism.
Expand your farming empire and become wealthy in the process.
This questbook will give you an introduction to the concepts of the pack, and serve as a journal for collectable items.
You only have to read this one
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest42BBE95A6: Many recipes in this pack are modified or require currency.
Like games such as Stardew Valley and Harvest Moon, exploit the earth for profit!
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest4F7FB7C88: Press &6o&r to enable, provided your PC has the specs capable for them.
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest5FB57C45A: Sunlit Valley is a more peaceful oriented modpack! This means:
- Inventory is kept on death (Though tool durability will be lost)
- Phantoms and Pillager patrols no longer spawn
This doesn't mean there's no danger however. &6The underground, Nether, and Skull Cavern are as dangerous as ever&r....
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest5FDA526D3: The FTB Chunks map is disabled to prevent confusion from having two maps.
If you're familiar with modded minecraft and prefer that map, click the check mark!
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest67486880F: This pack has a lot of animals that can make sounds that get old very quickly.
To mute specific mobs/sounds, you can click on the volume icon in your inventory.

If you dislike the ambient sounds in the pack, you can edit the file &6config/ambientsounds-client.json&r and set the volume to a lower value. You can also just remove the mod without losing the ability to connect to servers using the pack.
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest6EA561818: This pack has a configuration! Things like multiplayer sharestones or hospital fees can be turned on or off.
In the modpack folder, go to the folder &6kubejs&r and then &6startup_scripts&r.
Find the file &6_config.js&r, and open it up with Notepad. Update the values save the file, and restart the game.
If you're on a server, the server admin may need to change these values as well.
Want to change something? Do it!
ftbquests.chapter.welcome.quest7A7B131D2: Spice of Life: Onion Edition has been added to incentivize eating different foods.
Reaching certain thresholds of food diversity will give you benefits listed in the book. Most notably: extra health!
